newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyushu Oil plans no 1997 shutdown of Oita topper.
newsitem.headline: Kyushu Oil plans no 1997 shutdown of Oita topper.

text.p: Kyushu Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday it plans no shutdown for routine maintenance this year at the bigger of the two crude distillation units at its Oita refinery, on Japan's major southern island of Kyushu.

The refiner said the 116,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) topper would not undergo routine maintenance, although the other topper at the plant, with a processing capacity of 20,000 bpd, will be closed for about 20 days in October for maintenance checks.
